item.text: {"summary":"Draft is close to publishable, with one coherence fix needed and one resolver-text tightening recommended.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"blocking","summary":"The prior/update math names a +0.07 momentum adjustment and a +0.01 denominator-contraction adjustment, but then computes 79.75 + 0.07 = 79.82; the stated components imply either 79.83 or that the +0.01 is already included in the +0.07.","actionRequested":"Clarify the adjustment decomposition so the components sum to the 79.82 point estimate, e.g. state that the net update is +0.07 total or revise the point estimate/math consistently."},{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft resolver fields match the target in substance, but the resolutionRule omits the ledger’s explicit basis for the scheduled refresh date and the June 2026 reference computation.","actionRequested":"Add the phrase that the 2026-07-29 schedule is per the dataset metastore next-update field, and include the June 2026 reference computation if the schema allows preserving the full ledger resolver text."}],"optionalSuggestions":["In the final reasoning, explicitly label the method as a persistence-plus-recent-monthly-trend model to satisfy the model-prior check cleanly.","Tie the lower-tail facility-population scenario to the all-rows-with-both-fields-populated rule, since row inclusion can directly affect the national weighted ratio."]}
